about.title: About Flexijob
about.intro_desc:
Flexijob is your platform for finding flexible, short-term work that fits around your life as a student.
 We understand how busy student life can get, and we built Flexijob to make earning and growing on the side as simple as possible. 
Browse shifts across different industries, pick what suits your schedule, and earn extra income while building real experience.

No fixed hours. No long-term commitments.

As Egypt's first platform of its kind, we're proud to support students like you.
about.step_1: Browse available shifts and apply after reviewing the details.
about.step_2: Your application becomes Pending while the business reviews it.
about.step_3: Once accepted, the shift appears in your Accepted shifts and you're ready to go.
about.checkin_desc: When you arrive at your shift location, make sure to Check In through your shifts page.
about.checkout_desc:
When your shift ends, tap Check Out from the same page. 
This is required to record your hours and process your payment.
about.strikes_desc:
To protect everyone's rights, we use a strikes system.
 Accumulating 3 strikes leads to a permanent ban.
about.strikes_rule: Canceling an accepted shift less than 24 hours before it starts will result in a strike.
about.acceptance_desc:
Acceptance depends on factors like application timing, gender, and location, and may vary between businesses. 
Don't worry if you're not accepted for a shift. 
After each completed shift, businesses will rate you, and your rating will affect future opportunities.
about.closing: Thank you for using Flexijob. We're glad to have you on board!
